treatment_summary: Start high‑intensity atorvastatin 40 mg daily and add amlodipine 5 mg daily to achieve BP target, initiate metformin 500 mg BID for diabetes prevention, continue existing ACE‑I, inhaled therapies, iron, and opioid regimen while arranging opioid‑stewardship review. Add duloxetine 30 mg daily and PRN acetaminophen as non‑opioid analgesic adjuncts. Monitor lipids, BP, HbA1c, renal function, CK/LFTs, and drug interactions per NICE guidelines. Provide lifestyle counselling (weight loss, diet, exercise) and refer to diabetes prevention and pain‑management services.
